Criterion.description:
An executable eligibility criterion.

`text` states the condition. For an `include` criterion a record must meet it; for an
`exclude` criterion a record that shows it is excluded. Either way the judge answers whether
the record *passes*: `not_met` with a verified quote is what excludes.
Criterion.title: Criterion

Deviation.description: A justified departure from a required source plan, e.g. a source that cannot be searched.
Deviation.title: Deviation

PageTriage.description: Whether a page's text layer can be trusted (pdf-inspector plus a PyMuPDF check).
PageTriage.title: PageTriage

ReferenceSet.description: Known relevant records: the strategy is built on one set and validated on the other.
ReferenceSet.title: ReferenceSet

ReviewQuestion.description: One question or population of the review. Decisions are keyed by it as a scope.
ReviewQuestion.title: ReviewQuestion

Scope.description: One review question or search topic that decisions are keyed by.
Scope.title: Scope

SourceRecord.description:
One record as a source returned it, before dedupe.

`occurrence_id` is assigned when the search module stores the execution; corpus and every
later stage refer to records by it.
SourceRecord.title: SourceRecord

StoppingPlan.description: When an M3 topic may stop screening in AI order.
StoppingPlan.title: StoppingPlan

get.description: An anchor with its quote, offsets, one box per line, and table cells.

post.description: Store a PDF and parse its base layer. Uploading the same bytes again is a no-op.

get.description: The page, unrotated, at `scale` pixels per PDF point.

post.description:
Anchor a verbatim quote. 404 if the layer does not contain it, 409 if it occurs more than
once and no `occurrence` is given.
